 526 |     def get_attr_id(self, title, attr_type, edge_or_node, default, mode):

 528 |         try:

 530 |         except KeyError:
 531 |             # generate new id
 532 |             new_id = str(next(self.attr_id))
 533 |             self.attr[edge_or_node][mode][title] = new_id
 534 |             attr_kwargs = {"id": new_id, "title": title, "type": attr_type}
 535 |             attribute = Element("attribute", **attr_kwargs)
 536 |             # add subelement for data default value if present
 537 |             default_title = default.get(title)
 538 |             if default_title is not None:
 539 |                 default_element = Element("default")
 540 |                 default_element.text = str(default_title)
 541 |                 attribute.append(default_element)
 542 |             # new insert it into the XML
 543 |             attributes_element = None
 544 |             for a in self.graph_element.findall("attributes"):
 545 |                 # find existing attributes element by class and mode
 546 |                 a_class = a.get("class")
 547 |                 a_mode = a.get("mode", "static")
